notes: Review & swap gets a "Coming Up" workflow. Press E (or Pick) on the shots you want and they turn green and collect in a PW Picks bin; open Picks → Extract and PW Studio builds a new "<sequence> — Coming Up" multicam from just those shots, compressed back-to-back, with every camera stacked so 1–9 / R / X all work on the reel. You can set the Pick colour and label in Settings → Pick for Coming Up. Also in this build: pressing X (Split here) now cuts EVERY camera's video and audio at the playhead so the whole stack stays aligned for shuffle; pressing C (Flag) now colours the shot's audio as well as its video; the first Analyse now has a Cancel button; each flag in the Flags list has a note field for leaving yourself a reminder; and the tool now follows Premiere's active sequence — switch sequences and it re-points to the one you're looking at. Fixes: the Flags list no longer needs a Reveal first to show your flags, and on-screen messages now fade away quickly instead of lingering (hover a message to keep it up while you read).
